cases.title: K-9 Saxon: Oxyglobin, survival and the legacy of the Saxon Award
cases.summary: Fresno Police K-9 Saxon survived catastrophic line-of-duty injuries in 2002. A letter from Police Chief Jerry Dyer in Biopure's 2002 Annual Report credited Oxyglobin with a pivotal role in Saxon's survival. Fresno Police later established the Saxon Award in his honor.
